title: Morning Brief — Wednesday, 16 September 2026
description: Today: new research finds Australia's pre-colonial Indigenous population was far larger than previously thought, and global bond yields climb past 5%; a Mount Isa suburb is overwhelmed by flying foxes and Brisbane detectives charge a man with 42 property offences; and the Gold Coast takes a housing affordability ruling to the High Court as police charge 15 people in a major drug operation. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
